t: The Fortress Trade single door dust guard provides an effective barrier for construction and renovation projects. Measuring 0.95 x 2.15m, this dust barrier is designed to seal off standard doorways, preventing dust and debris from transferring between rooms during building work or painting. It is ideal for professional builders, painters, and renovators working on domestic or commercial properties. The dust guard includes 10m of duct tape for secure installation. It is wipe clean and reusable, offering a practical solution for maintaining clean work environments.
